metadata.description: Parallel analysis of customer churn patterns vs revenue trends across market segments

turns.content: I want to explore two questions today. First, I want to understand customer churn — which customers stopped ordering. Second, I want to track revenue trends over time. Let's start with customer churn analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread A: customer churn analysis

turns.content: Show me customers who ordered in Q1 1995 but had no orders in Q2 1995. I want to understand who churned.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify customers with Q1 orders but no Q2 orders

turns.content: For churn analysis, always focus on the C_MKTSEGMENT column to categorize customers.

annotations.establishesFilter: Use C_MKTSEGMENT for customer categorization (Thread A)
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use C_MKTSEGMENT for Thread A analysis

turns.content: Now let's switch to Thread B. I want to analyze revenue trends. Show me monthly revenue for 1995.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread B: revenue trend analysis

turns.content: For revenue analysis, always use O_ORDERDATE as the date column, not any other date field.

annotations.establishesFilter: Use O_ORDERDATE for all date filtering (Thread B)
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use O_ORDERDATE for Thread B queries

turns.content: Cross-reference: Do the market segments with declining revenue in Thread B match the segments with high churn in Thread A?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare segment performance across both threads

turns.content: Thread A: Show me the average order value for churned customers vs retained customers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare AOV for churned vs retained customers

turns.content: Thread B: Show me the same comparison.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply AOV comparison to Thread B (revenue analysis)

turns.content: That's not what I meant. I meant for Thread B, show me monthly revenue compared to the previous month.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show month-over-month revenue comparison

turns.content: Earlier in Thread A, you showed me the market segments for churned customers. What was the breakdown?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall market segment breakdown for churned customers

turns.content: Thread B: Remember to use O_ORDERDATE for all revenue calculations.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm O_ORDERDATE usage for Thread B

turns.content: Thread A: Exclude customers from 'MIDDLE EAST' region from all churn analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply MIDDLE EAST exclusion to Thread A

turns.content: Thread A: From now on, only analyze customers with more than 2 orders total — single-order customers are noise.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter for customers with >2 orders in Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: From now on, only analyze revenue from orders with status 'O' — we want open orders.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter for O_ORDERSTATUS = 'O' in Thread B

turns.content: Final synthesis: Summarize the key findings from both threads and their relationship.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should synthesize findings from both churn and revenue analysis

turns.content: Thread A: Confirm all active filters for this thread.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: use C_MKTSEGMENT, exclude MIDDLE EAST, >2 orders

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Use C_MKTSEGMENT for customer categorization in Thread A
persistedCorrections.description: Always use C_MKTSEGMENT for Thread A customer categorization

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Use O_ORDERDATE for all date filtering in Thread B
persistedCorrections.description: Use O_ORDERDATE for Thread B revenue analysis

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude MIDDLE EAST region for Thread A
persistedCorrections.description: Filter out MIDDLE EAST customers for Thread A only

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Only analyze customers with >2 orders in Thread A
persistedCorrections.description: Exclude single-order and 2-order customers from Thread A

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Only analyze orders with status 'O' in Thread B
persistedCorrections.description: Filter for O_ORDERSTATUS = 'O' in Thread B

Use O_ORDERDATE for Thread B date filtering
